title: HospitalBench: Diagnosing Where and Why Embodied Agents Fail on Long Hospital Task Chains
abstract: arXiv:2611.19274v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Long-horizon embodied tasks fail in ways that end-task success cannot see. HospitalBench is a diagnostic benchmark of ten hospital chores in NVIDIA Isaac Sim, each two unscored warm-up steps followed by a causal chain of five scored sub-tasks in one continuous simulation: the state one step leaves (an object pose, a choice, a fact seen once) determines what the next step must do, unlike benchmarks that place sub-tasks side by side. Vision-language agents act through skill-level tools from camera images. A scripted robot that makes only the calls a model gets is the solvability check of a chore. From each trajectory the benchmark reads where a chain breaks, what the agent did after a failed call, and how far its own position estimate drifts from the true one. translated_title: HospitalBench：诊断具身智能体在长时程医院任务链中失败的位置与原因
translated_abstract: 长时程具身任务的失败方式是仅凭最终任务成败无法察觉的。HospitalBench 是一个诊断性基准，包含 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中的十项医院杂务，每项任务由两个不计分的预热步骤和一条由五个计分子任务组成的因果链构成，均在同一次连续仿真中完成：上一步留下的状态（物体位姿、某个选择、仅见过一次的事实）决定了下一步必须做什么，这与将子任务并列放置的基准不同。视觉-语言智能体通过技能级工具并依据相机图像进行操作。一个只执行模型所获调用的脚本化机器人充当每项任务可解性的检验标准。基准从每条轨迹中读出：任务链在何处断裂、智能体在调用失败后做了什么，以及其自身位置估计与真实位置的偏差有多大。本版本仅报告初步结果：60 次计划运行中的 15 次（三个高投入模型，任务 T1 和 T10 从两个起始状态各运行一次，T3 从一个起始状态运行一次），以及脚本化……
tldr: 该论文提出 HospitalBench，一个在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中构建的诊断性基准，通过具有因果依赖的医院长任务链，定位并解释具身智能体失败的具体环节与原因。
en_tdlr: HospitalBench is a diagnostic benchmark in NVIDIA Isaac Sim that pinpoints where and why embodied agents fail on long hospital task chains with causal inter-step dependencies.
